label: File storage
description: Optional. Connect your own bucket in Cloudflare R2, Amazon S3, Backblaze B2 or Wasabi to upload files from a product's Actions menu. Files stay private, and each download gets a link that expires after 5 minutes. After saving, choose Actions → Test connection.

actions.label: Test connection
actions.hint: Checks the access key by writing and reading a small test file in the folder.

fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: Your bucket's S3 API address, like https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com. The region is read from it. Leave empty for Amazon S3 in us-east-1.

fields.label: Folder
fields.description: Uploads go into this folder of the bucket.

fields.label: Access key ID
fields.description: Limit the key to this bucket and folder, allowing PutObject, GetObject, AbortMultipartUpload and ListMultipartUploadParts.

fields.label: Secret access key
fields.description: Masked here, but admins can show it.
